name: Pipeliners - City Page Drafts (SEO Baseline Folder) 2026-10-10
body:
> Plan · Pipeliners · 2026-10-10

# Summary
One note for the city page drafts kept in the `seo-baseline-2026-09-10` folder between Sep 16 and Oct 10, 2026. Each draft is built from that page's own GSC queries, follows the house rules ("Pipeliners" not "Pipeliners USA", no "pipe lining" noun, no em dashes, verified claims only) and routes titles, H1s and metas through OTTO.

# Drafts, oldest first
- `step7-title-drafts-2026-09-16.md`: titles and metas for Fort McDowell, Maricopa, Litchfield Park; Florence kept (already #1 in Phoenix for "florence pipe break repair"). og:titles contradicted the titles on 3 of 4 pages. The scorecard records Step 7 and Step 8 as applied Sep 15 to 16.
- `step8-city-pages-draft-2026-09-16.md`: Tempe, Mesa, Gilbert, Fountain Hills. Content did not use the searched words ("sewer line replacement" on 0 of 4 pages; Mesa had 0 "sewer line repair" despite 137 impressions). Plan: aligned titles and H1s, one new section per page, links from 5 neighbouring city pages.
- `quick-wins-draft-2026-09-17.md`: Florence, Phoenix, Chandler, Hydro Jetting, Queen Creek. LIVE (applied Sep 16 17:25 UTC, approved Sep 17). None was a paid landing page.
- `headings-draft-2026-09-17.md`: Sun City, Sun City West, Sun Lakes (OTTO headings never matched because it looked for "SunCity") and /services/ (no H1). LIVE Sep 16; menu labels reset after a side effect.
- `gold-canyon-draft-2026-09-26.md`: focus "sewer line replacement in Gold Canyon, AZ"; title, meta and copy changes. The city page audit records Gold Canyon as rewritten Sep 26.
- `scottsdale-anthem-surprise-draft-2026-10-02.md`: focus "sewer line replacement in Scottsdale, AZ" and similar alignment for Anthem and Surprise; zero paid impressions on all three. Scottsdale and Anthem were changed Oct 2 per the early check.
- `maricopa-draft-2026-10-03.md`: focus "sewer lining in Maricopa, AZ"; skip manhole terms (not offered). Maricopa was edited Oct 3.
- `anthem-rewrite-draft-2026-10-07.md`: full Anthem copy from a client text extract, edited to house rules; focus stays "sewer line replacement in Anthem, AZ". Draft; ad check owed.
- `scottsdale-content-refresh-draft-2026-10-10.md`: improved version of a ChatGPT draft; cut 7 repeated or unverifiable sections (for example commercial work not confirmed by Scott). Hold until the Oct 26 read.
